trace.cypher:
MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WITH p, CASE WHEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) > 10 OR (CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) = 10 AND CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) > 14) THEN 2026 - CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 0) AS INT64) - 1 ELSE 2026 - CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 0) AS INT64) END AS age, t
WHERE age < 42 AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) <= 1 AND (t.team_name = 'Detroit Pistons' OR p.college = 'Temple University')
RETURN DISTINCT p.college AS col1, age AS col2, p.position AS col3, p.name AS name_player
